---

Research complete — the runtime error stems from missing image assets (`/assets/cosmic-portals/eclipse-*.jpg`). Textures can’t load, Three.js throws, and the Suspense boundary explodes. Recommendations logged in T-28 research note:

1. Add properly named JPGs under `apps/app/public/assets/cosmic-portals/`.  
2. Or update code to point at the existing PNG filenames.  
3. Optionally add a graceful fallback texture when load fails.

Let me know which path you prefer (supply images vs. rename paths vs. procedural fallback), and I’ll move T-28 → “In Progress” and implement the chosen fix, then tackle navigation and other animation pages.
